name: Kara Lenardson
prior_offices: Weston County assessor (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Kara Lenardson is the Weston County assessor and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. Official February 4, 2025, commissioners minutes record her appearing before the board as assessor. The News Letter Journal reported that she was unopposed in the August 2026 Republican primary.

sources.name: News Letter Journal, Weston County certifies 2026 primary results
